why_this_file_exists: Rows where ops/config/rule-enforcement-map.json classes a rule as BUILT while audits/rule-enforceability-audit-2026-08-14.tsv still has it in bucket U, enforcement specified and not built. These are not the map being newer. The map derives enforcement_class from the CATEGORY a rule sits in, so a rule sorted into one of the four non-advisory buckets reads as backed by that bucket's control whether or not the control addresses it. Each `reason` below is the auditor's own evidence text saying why it does not. Deciding that question is a judgment, and overturning it is not a check's business, so they are recorded here instead.
the_debt_may_only_shrink: ops/map-row-evidence-check.py fails on a NEW overstatement immediately, and also fails on an entry here whose row has since been reconciled or that no longer contradicts. Removing an entry means fixing the row, never deleting the record.
how_to_clear_one: Either build the control the rule actually needs and re-triage the audit row out of bucket U, or correct the map row to a class that does not overstate what the assigned control covers. Then delete the entry here.
